purpose: Exploratory comparison of Git log grep with full commit enumeration followed by git cat-file --batch. This is not an official 20-round API acceptance benchmark.

method.catFile: git rev-list --topo-order --branches --remotes piped to git cat-file --batch; parse commit messages and stop matching after 51 OIDs
method.orderCheck: The first 51 matching OIDs were identical for both commands for each sample.

conclusion: The batch object scan preserved the sampled result order but was slower for both queries, so it was not adopted.
limitations: Three exploratory samples per case do not establish P95 or a stable performance distribution.
The experiment measured Git commands directly and did not include the HTTP API or SQLite index.
